question: Does Direxion's public official SOXL product page or its directly linked holdings download provide a date-stamped 2011-2022 daily fund size/shares series and historical first-public vintages needed to estimate leveraged ETF end-of-day rebalancing demand, rather than relying on a price-only late tracking residual?
motivation: The fixed signed late ETF price residual passed source/novelty but failed the SOXX cash-cap local information gate. Actual rebalance-demand estimation would need fund size and investor flows; this is a different source requirement, not a retest of the failed residual coordinate.
method: Capture exact official response bytes, UTC request/response time, HTTP status, content type, size and SHA256. Parse only issuer page anchors for Daily Fund Holdings and any explicit historic AUM/shares downloads. Follow at most one direct same-issuer CSV link if it is clearly labelled and within budget. Inspect rows/headers/date coverage and whether the page/download states original publication or revision timing. Archive exact received bytes to Yanxuan NAS with remote SHA and scoped readback. Do not scrape news or use a third-party estimate.
acceptance: A usable factor source would require fund-size/shares fields for the relevant daily 2011-2022 training history, 2023-2026 reused evaluation coverage, split-aware units and auditable first availability before the next Stage1 decision. A current snapshot, holdings-only table, quarterly filing, or historical values with unknown first publication is source_only_needs_data.
scientific_boundary: No SOXX market outcome, model, factor fit, account, purchase, vendor outreach or qualified forward day. This card cannot reopen the closed late residual information experiment; a real fund-flow mechanism would need a new frozen formula and receiver after source qualification.
stop: Stop after the bounded requests or a non-200/oversized/untrusted-host response. Preserve failures and exact bytes; do not infer absent historical data merely from one page if the site may expose another official endpoint.
